claim: Gastric-BOLD coupling strength was unrelated to BOLD power at gastric frequency.
source: Third, we verified that gastric-BOLD coupling strength was unrelated to BOLD power at gastric frequency. We computed the correlation between BOLD power at gastric frequency and coupling strength for each participant and voxel, and found the two measures to be unrelated (Fisher z-transformed Pearson correlation coefficients tested against zero, t(29)=1.19, p=0.24; Bayes factor <0.001, indicating decisive evidence for the absence of a link between coupling strength across the brain and BOLD power at gastric frequency).
evidence: Supported by statistical test results from the study data

claim: Coupling strength and voxel motion were unrelated.

evidence: Supported by statistical test results from the study data
